# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "russian_core_principalities_settlements.json"

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

# Sort chronologically by first occupied year, then alphabetically by name
first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

translit_cyr <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  if (!nzchar(s)) return("")
  cyr <- c(
    "А","Б","В","Г","Д","Е","Ё","Ж","З","И","Й","К","Л","М","Н","О","П","Р","С","Т","У","Ф","Х","Ц","Ч","Ш","Щ","Ъ","Ы","Ь","Э","Ю","Я",
    "а","б","в","г","д","е","ё","ж","з","и","й","к","л","м","н","о","п","р","с","т","у","ф","х","ц","ч","ш","щ","ъ","ы","ь","э","ю","я"
  )
  lat <- c(
    "A","B","V","G","D","E","Yo","Zh","Z","I","Y","K","L","M","N","O","P","R","S","T","U","F","Kh","Ts","Ch","Sh","Shch","","Y","","E","Yu","Ya",
    "a","b","v","g","d","e","yo","zh","z","i","y","k","l","m","n","o","p","r","s","t","u","f","kh","ts","ch","sh","shch","","y","","e","yu","ya"
  )
  for (i in seq_along(cyr)) {
    s <- gsub(cyr[i], lat[i], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  s <- gsub("Dukhovshchina", "Dukhov-shchina", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Duchowschtschina", "Duchow-schtschina", s, fixed = TRUE)
  return(s)
}

fmt_settlement_name <- function (arg0_name) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_name)
  s <- gsub("Dukhovshchina", "Dukhov-shchina", s, fixed = TRUE)
  return(s)
}

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(gsub("-", "", clean_vec)) != tolower(gsub("-", "", arg0_s$name))]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) {
    clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  }
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])))
  lat <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", lat, perl = TRUE)
  lat <- sub(",0+$", "", lat, perl = TRUE)
  lon <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])))
  lon <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", lon, perl = TRUE)
  lon <- sub(",0+$", "", lon, perl = TRUE)
  return(paste0(lat, "°N, ", lon, "°E"))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles coordinates, historical names and benchmark population estimates for 258 settlements across the Russian Core and the Middle Volga (~1,94M km²) from 10000BC to 1900AD. It accompanies the regional demographic survey of the eight principalities by tracking individual camps, hillforts, villages and towns from Mesolithic peat-bog sites (such as Nizhneye Veretye I and Zamostje 2) and Early Iron Age Dyakovo and Gorodets bluff forts to the provincial capitals and industrial cities of the late Russian Empire.

Before the Mongol invasion of 1236-1240AD, urban life peaked in the great river trading capitals of Bilyar (50k), Veliky Novgorod (28k), Smolensk (25k), Vladimir-on-Klyazma (22k) and Old Ryazan (18k). After the thirteenth-century sack of the southern and eastern capitals, town growth shifted during the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries to the Golden Horde mint cities of Bolgar (40k) and Mukhshi and to the rising appanage seats of Moscow (40k by 1450AD) and Tver. From the sixteenth to the nineteenth centuries, the founding of southern fortress towns along the Belgorod and Simbirsk lines, the building of Saint Petersburg after 1703 and late nineteenth-century railway and textile expansion carried Saint Petersburg to 1,26M and Moscow to 1,04M in the 1897 census.

# Methodology

This gazetteer sets out the locations, historical names and benchmark population estimates for 258 settlements across the eight historical regions of the Russian Core and the Middle Volga: Novgorod and Pskov, Vladimir-Suzdal and Rostov-Yaroslavl, Moscow and Tver, Ryazan and the Upper Don, Smolensk and the Upper Dnieper, Chernigov-Bryansk and the Upper Oka, Nizhny Novgorod, Vyatka and Great Perm, and the Middle Volga and Cis-Urals.

Population figures are drawn from excavated house floors and settlement plans for Mesolithic, Neolithic, Bronze Age and Early Iron Age sites [@Zhilin2019; @Oshibkina2006; @Kostyleva2014; @Kostyleva2022; @Nordqvist2020; @Engovatova2021], walled town areas (*detinets* and *okolny gorod*) and outer craft quarters (*posad*) for Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria and Golden Horde towns [@Tikhomirov1956; @Kuza1989; @Kuza1996; @Nosov1990; @Darkevich1995; @Eniosova2012; @Khuzin2001; @Rudenko2012; @Nedashkovsky2000; @Belorybkin2022; @Belavin2023], and Muscovite tax books (*pistsovye knigi*), Imperial poll-tax revisions (*revizii*) and the 1897 census for early modern and nineteenth-century towns [@Kopanev1959; @Shapiro1971; @Vodarsky1973; @Vodarsky1977; @Kabuzan1963; @Kabuzan1971; @Rashin1956; @Mironov2000; @Troynitsky1905].

# Results

## Prehistoric, Bronze Age and Early Iron Age Settlements

Table \ref{tab:rc-ancient} lists the Mesolithic peat-bog camps, Neolithic longhouse villages, Bronze Age herding settlements and Early Iron Age river hillforts occupied up to 800AD.

```{r tab-rc-ancient, results='asis'}
ancient_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 800, settlements_list)

df_ancient <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ancient_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = fmt_settlement_name(s$name),
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Pop_History = fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 800),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_ancient,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric and Early Iron Age sites across the Russian Core and the Middle Volga, giving coordinates, dates of occupation and population estimates derived from excavated house floors, cemetery counts and bluff-top hillfort enclosures.",
    label = "tab:rc-ancient",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Occupied Span", "Population Estimates by Date"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

## Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria and Golden Horde Settlements

Table \ref{tab:rc-medieval} tracks the walled towns and major rural settlements of Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria, Great Perm and the northern Golden Horde *uluses* across five medieval benchmarks.

```{r tab-rc-medieval, results='asis'}
med_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 850 & yrs <= 1500)
}, settlements_list)

df_med <- do.call(rbind, lapply(med_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = fmt_settlement_name(s$name),
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_950_1000 = get_pop_window_val(s, 850, 1020),
    P_1150 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1080, 1170),
    P_1200_1235 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1180, 1236),
    P_1300_1350 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1250, 1360),
    P_1400_1500 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1390, 1510),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Populations of medieval towns and large villages at five benchmark windows, contrasting the pre-Mongol peak (1200 - 1235AD) at Bilyar, Veliky Novgorod, Smolensk, Vladimir and Old Ryazan with the fourteenth- and fifteenth-century recovery under the appanage princes and Golden Horde khans.",
    label = "tab:rc-medieval",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical Names", "Coords", "1000AD", "1150AD", "1200-1235AD", "1300-1350AD", "1500AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

## Muscovite and Imperial Settlements

Table \ref{tab:rc-modern} follows the provincial capitals, fortress towns and industrial centres of the Russian Core from the sixteenth-century Muscovite cadastres to the 1897 census and 1900AD.

```{r tab-rc-modern, results='asis'}
mod_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 1550)
}, settlements_list)

df_mod <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mod_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = fmt_settlement_name(s$name),
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_1600 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1550, 1650),
    P_1700 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1670, 1725),
    P_1800 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1780, 1825),
    P_1850 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1840, 1865),
    P_1897 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1895, 1898),
    P_1900 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1899, 1905),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_mod,
  list(
    caption = "Town populations across six early modern and imperial benchmarks, showing the seventeenth-century founding of southern frontier forts along the Belgorod and Simbirsk lines, the rise of Saint Petersburg after 1703 and late nineteenth-century railway and factory growth.",
    label = "tab:rc-modern",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "1600AD", "1700AD", "1800AD", "1850AD", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```
